solution_concept: perfect Bayesian equilibrium under the Gate 0 consequential-equality response convention

state.public_history_index: full h2 after completed and irreversible H opt-out
state.recognition: one weak proposer i is drawn uniformly from the m weak states
state.beliefs: theta is payoff- and action-irrelevant; no posterior is required for this continuation payoff
state.hegemon_accounting: the Round-1 outside payoff has already been realized and is not paid again

primitive_domain.original_quota: q=floor(N/2)+1, not recalculated after H opt-out
primitive_domain.proposal: x in the m-dimensional unit simplex; x_i is the proposer residual
primitive_domain.pass_payoffs: weak vector x and H current flow 0
primitive_domain.failure_payoffs: zero current flow for every player
primitive_domain.randomization: independent behavioral randomization conditional on each information set

ballot_interface.notation: p_j is nonproposer j's yes probability; a is the count p_j=1; c is the count 0<p_j<1; ell=a+c
ballot_interface.relevance_probability: rho_j=Pr(sum of other nonproposer yes votes equals t-1)
ballot_interface.response_condition: p_j<1 implies rho_j=0; when rho_j>0 the required response is yes, including payoff equality
ballot_interface.pure_specialization: number a of yes votes satisfies a>=t or a<=t-2
ballot_interface.full_profile_warning: pass and failure completions are distinct assessment-level classes and cannot be quotiented by playerwise local irrelevance

proposal_strategy_interface.completion_map: for every feasible proposal s, kappa_i(s) must choose a full ballot profile in one of the two ballot classes
proposal_strategy_interface.induced_pass_indicator: d_i(s)=1 for the certain-pass class and 0 for the certain-failure class
proposal_strategy_interface.necessary_and_sufficient_optimality: the measurable proposer strategy is supported on the nonempty argmax of g_i
proposal_strategy_interface.proposal_tie_break: vacuous here because H's current and already-realized payoffs are identical across all tied proposals; retain downstream differences

N_equals_3.ballot: unique yes by the sole nonproposer at every proposal

conditional_on_recognized_proposer.N_at_least_4_behavioral_payoff_set: S_i=Delta_m union {v in R_+^m: v_i=0 and sum_j v_j<=1}
conditional_on_recognized_proposer.multiplicity: a continuum of proposal-contingent completion maps, proposal strategies, and payoff vectors

pre_recognition_continuation.N_at_least_4_behavioral: C2_M_WO(h2)={(0_H,w): w=(1/m) sum_i v^i and v^i in S_i}
pre_recognition_continuation.N_at_least_4_pure: replace S_i by S_i^pure in the preceding Minkowski-average formula
pre_recognition_continuation.history_index: the same value correspondence applies at every full h2, but completion strategies may differ by h2
pre_recognition_continuation.downstream_consumption_rule: import the full correspondence assessment by assessment; do not select a scalar locally

existence_and_boundaries.N_equals_4: all yes is the only pass completion and all no is the only failure completion
existence_and_boundaries.N_at_least_4: both passage and failure PBEs exist at every history; the all-failure PBE exists
existence_and_boundaries.equality: a relevant voter chooses yes when monetary payoffs tie
existence_and_boundaries.off_path: proposal-contingent completions are assessment components and must satisfy the ballot condition at every proposal

gifts_and_support.zero_gift_or_minimal_support_result: rejected in the unrestricted PBE correspondence
gifts_and_support.positive_gifts: supported on a relatively open set of passing proposals whenever N>=4
gifts_and_support.gate0_counterexample_survives: yes; N=4 all-no failure and all-yes passage are distinct completions despite individual local irrelevance at all no

verification.scope: pure enumeration for N=3..15; mixed-grid equivalence for N=3..9; boundary, deterministic-outcome, gift, oversized-support, and payoff-construction checks

invalidation: any change to the frozen Gate 0 hash, retained original quota, equality response, independent randomization, gift payment, or weak-only residual budget invalidates this interface and all descendants
artifact_hash_policy: the exact UTF-8 JSON bytes are hashed externally after serialization; no self-referential hash is embedded
